decisions.reason: Actual strategy/interpreter C and injected-hook workflow. Incremental replacement alongside original game with expanded-memory tooling; not full native port or completed matching build.

decisions.title: Azure Dreams PSX modding research
decisions.reason: Shop patcher and separate unfinished second-town work with sector EDC/ECC repair. Modifies disc images; source was read only here. Finished shop features do not establish completion of town expansion or full decompilation.

decisions.title: DIS68K historical disassembler
decisions.reason: Preserved1993-era C decoder with later68030 additions and reassemblable output mode. Historical conio/runtime assumptions remain; not complete modern ISA or portability guarantee.

decisions.title: clown68000 CPU and disassembler library
decisions.reason: ANSI C interpreter/disassembler library. Author explicitly prioritizes performance over cycle accuracy; CPU support is not whole-system emulation.

decisions.title: Acorn OnliBasic extension disassembly
decisions.reason: Variant-specific listings and analysis scripts for System/Atom/TOSDOS contexts with named clock/port state. Not a single identical ROM across all variants; no independent rebuild performed.

decisions.title: Black Acorn Atom sign ROM disassembly
decisions.reason: ES5700 Pearce sign-system ROM with named cursor/buffer/VIA state and disassembly driver. Special-purpose Black Atom firmware,not generic Atom BASIC or OS.

decisions.title: Apple Pascal p-code disassembler
decisions.reason: Proof-of-concept codefile/segment reader and p-code instruction/jump-table decoder. Targets virtual-machine code,not native6502 instructions; malformed-file robustness untested.

decisions.title: libres Macintosh resource library
decisions.reason: C resource-fork reader with public/internal API source. File-format library rather than resource GUI or complete all-resource semantic decoder.

decisions.title: KSFL structured binary-format library
decisions.reason: Mac/Palm/PE/DFF/chunk-format APIs and CLI. Implemented Java MacResourceFile reviewed; other-language support is planned,not shipped by inference.

decisions.title: Macintosh resource Kaitai specifications
decisions.reason: Concrete WIND/BNDL/version/template format schemas with offsets and documentation. Core resource-fork/compression schemas moved to official Kaitai repo; this repository retains individual resource formats.

decisions.title: Resplendence resource editor
decisions.reason: Substantive Java Finder/resource editor rewrite. Author calls it unfinished; KSFL,PowerPaint and OpenXION are separate build dependencies,not bundled capabilities assumed present.

decisions.title: Exhume matching-decompilation toolkit
decisions.reason: Actual per-function masked matching and original-toolchain runners plus agent workflows. Extracted from tracked Underworld Exhumed but separately reusable; masked fixup matches differ from final whole-file byte equality.

decisions.title: RAD DOS preservation reconstruction
decisions.reason: Typed segmented C recovered from assembly/Reko with hardware/DOS boundary replacements. Actual functions and register/output modelling inspected; whole-game fidelity and completion not independently demonstrated.

decisions.title: TRS-80 TypeScript tool suite
decisions.reason: Coherent monorepo of Z80 assembler/disassembler/emulator,media libraries and IDE. BASIC decoder distinguishes tape/disk headers; ModelI/III support and other model work must not be conflated.

decisions.title: bas2uef BBC BASIC tape packager
decisions.reason: Tokenizes BBC BASIC2 source and packages cassette blocks into UEF. Specific BASIC dialect/media conversion,not a general BASIC compiler or universal tape encoder.

decisions.title: Acorn BBC BASIC 128 source restoration
decisions.reason: Original1.11 source plus missing/broken Bas10 reconstructed from disassembly and translated back to MASM. Keep original archive and repaired build source distinction; co-processor build not run here.

decisions.title: Madou Monogatari I PC Engine translation
decisions.reason: Translation source/assets/scripts and disc preparation tools. Requires matching original mixed-mode ISO/WAV/CUE image and dependencies; tools source does not include authorization to redistribute original game assets.

decisions.title: Galaxy Fraulein Yuna translation source
decisions.reason: Translation build,script spreadsheet and adventure-string overlay tools for original HCD2031 release. Specific disc track layout and ODS-to-CSV step retained; not all Yuna editions supported by inference.

decisions.title: TurboRip PC Engine disc ripper
decisions.reason: Win32 mixed-mode disc extraction/CUE generation with track-gap rules. Requires physical-drive/platform support; broad Windows/drive-perfect claims not independently tested and no disc accessed.

decisions.title: amiga-cc cross-toolchain setup
decisions.reason: Installer/build example for vbcc,vasm and vlink. Fetches vendor archives and edits shell environment via helper; no installation performed here and not an independent compiler.

decisions.title: libnix 3 Amiga C runtime source
decisions.reason: Updated standard C link-library sources from earlier libnix lineage with file/socket/timer fixes. Only changed nix component included,not a complete GCC SDK or all supporting libraries.

decisions.title: tb.lib Amiga AISS image library
decisions.reason: AISS logical-name artwork loading and BOOPSI/GadTools UI objects with per-process cache. Requires TBIMAGES assign,AISS assets and datatype stack; not a standalone PNG decoder or bundled artwork set.

decisions.title: ga.lib empty repository
decisions.reason: Repository commit lookup returns 409 Git Repository is empty. No implementation can be inspected; defer rather than infer from toolkit association.

notes: Parent-only pass across 48 broad and targeted platform/type searches: 227 hits, 224 distinct results. Four additional Amiga leads retained from earlier broad searches were freshly screened; all 42 selected repository URLs were new against current indexes. Forty-one additions and one empty-repository deferral. Inspected pinned source/tree and README, with actual game-code samples separated from shared SDK libraries. Compiler output classified carefully: bbc-c compiles C to a custom VM, while Pascal for Human Beings emits BBC BASIC; no native 6502 claim. Spectrum ROM presentations retain attribution and do not claim original independent authorship. Resource schema migration and external build dependencies retained. Tool AI features/configuration are not AI-authorship disclosure. Raw image patchers,rippers and installers were read only; no candidate code executed or user media modified. Historical source licensing and period toolchains remain explicit.
